# V2.4.1 - Watcher

Ask Fate in chat: “Watch this PR’s CI and tell me when it finishes.” Fate finds the pull request and pins its commit. The turn ends normally, and Fate posts the result in the original chat even if you’ve switched away. GitHub pull request links, Actions run links, and events from enabled local MCP connectors are supported.

**Run → Monitor → Watches** now shows watch status and lets you stop a watch. No setup form, run ID, or commit SHA is required for PR checks.

See [MCP and CI watches](https://github.com/Master0fFate/fateUI/blob/v2.4.1/docs/mcp.md) for examples and requirements.
